answer_1.quote: Researchers have begun utilizing LLMs to automatically review the literature and generate survey papers... We propose SURVEYFORGE, a novel automated framework for generating high-quality academic survey papers.

answer_2.quote: We introduce SurveyBench, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark, along with SAM (Survey Assessment Metrics), a multi-dimensional evaluation series... The SAM series integrate objective metrics, expert knowledge, and multi-dimensional criteria.

answer_3.quote: For evaluation, we leverage more advanced models, GPT-4o-2024-08-06 and Claude-3.5-sonnet-20241022, to assess both the AI-generated outlines and the content of the surveys.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a win rate framework, presenting the anonymized results of SURVEYFORGE and AutoSurvey to 20 PhD experts in computer science field... The experts evaluated outline quality and content quality using Score Win Rate and Comparative Win Rate.
answer_4.guideline: Experts were asked to rate outline quality and content quality, providing a Score Win Rate and a Comparative Win Rate for each system.
